stem.en: A poll reports 52% support for a policy, with a 95% confidence interval of 49% to 55%. What is the correct interpretation?
stem.et: Küsitlus teatab 52% toetust poliitikale, 95% usaldusvahemikuga 49% kuni 55%. Milline on õige tõlgendus?

label.en: If this polling procedure were repeated many times, about 95% of the resulting intervals would contain the true level of support in the population.
label.et: Kui seda küsitlusprotseduuri korrataks palju kordi, sisaldaks umbes 95% tekkivatest vahemikest populatsiooni tõelist toetuse taset.

label.en: There is a 95% probability that the true level of support is between 49% and 55%.
label.et: On 95% tõenäosus, et tõeline toetuse tase on 49% ja 55% vahel.

label.en: A narrower interval than 49-55% would automatically mean the poll was more accurate, regardless of its sample size.
label.et: Kitsam vahemik kui 49-55% tähendaks automaatselt, et küsitlus oli täpsem, sõltumata selle valimi suurusest.

label.en: Doubling the poll's sample size would eliminate essentially all of the remaining uncertainty in the estimate.
label.et: Küsitluse valimi suuruse kahekordistamine kõrvaldaks sisuliselt kogu hinnangus järelejäänud ebakindluse.
